Which compounds both contribute to acid rain?
A
carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide
B
carbon monoxide and oxides of nitrogen
C
oxides of nitrogen and sulfur dioxide
D
sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide

options.label: B
